workflow_metadata.name: schema_approval
workflow_metadata.description: Schema approval workflow with multi-stage review process

tasks.name: repeat_until_approved
tasks.description: Loop that repeats until approval is received
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to Python while loop with condition 'not approved'. Consider using continue-as-new if loop iterations could exceed 100 to prevent history bloat.

tasks.name: upload_schema
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to @activity.defn function. This is the first task in the approval loop.

tasks.name: fork_join
tasks.description: Parallel execution of two review tasks
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to asyncio.gather() with two activity executions in parallel: Review1.a and Review1.b

tasks.name: Review1.a
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Activity within FORK_JOIN parallel execution. May involve human review.

tasks.name: Review1.b
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Activity within FORK_JOIN parallel execution. May involve human review.

tasks.name: notification_join
tasks.description: Synchronization point waiting for both reviews
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: JOIN is implicit in Temporal when using asyncio.gather() - no explicit task needed. The gather() call automatically waits for all parallel activities to complete.

tasks.name: Review1Check
tasks.description: Conditional check based on user approval from Review1

input_parameters.expression: if (both approved) return YES; else return NO;

tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to if/elif statement. The reference to ${user_action.output.approved} indicates external input via Update or Signal. Recommend Update for approval validation.

tasks.name: Review2
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Activity executed when Review1Check results in YES. Part of nested conditional flow.

tasks.name: Review2Check
tasks.description: Conditional check for Review2 result, determining if Review3 is needed

input_parameters.expression: if (skippReview3) return YES; else return NO;

tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Nested SWITCH within another SWITCH. Translate to nested if/elif. References external approval input via Update or Signal.

tasks.name: CompleteReview
tasks.description: Completes review process when Review3 is skipped
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Activity executed when Review2Check results in YES (skip Review3). Sets approval flag to exit DO_WHILE loop.

tasks.name: Review3
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Activity executed when Review2Check results in NO (do not skip Review3). Part of deeply nested conditional flow.

tasks.name: Review3Check
tasks.description: Final conditional check for Review3 approval

input_parameters.expression: if (approved) return YES; else return NO;

tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Most deeply nested SWITCH statement. Translate to nested if/elif. References external approval input.

tasks.name: CompleteReview
tasks.description: Completes review process after Review3 approval
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Activity executed when Review3Check results in YES. Sets approval flag to exit DO_WHILE loop. Note: This has the deepest nesting level in the workflow.

human_interaction_patterns.timeout_behavior: No explicit timeout configured in Conductor workflow
human_interaction_patterns.notes: First approval checkpoint after parallel Review1.a and Review1.b tasks. Requires validation that both reviewers approved. Use Update with validation logic to ensure both reviews are complete before accepting approval.

human_interaction_patterns.timeout_behavior: No explicit timeout configured in Conductor workflow
human_interaction_patterns.notes: Second approval checkpoint determining whether Review3 is needed. Use Update to validate input and return decision result to caller.

human_interaction_patterns.timeout_behavior: No explicit timeout configured in Conductor workflow
human_interaction_patterns.notes: Final approval checkpoint in the deepest nesting level. Use Update with validation to confirm final approval before completing workflow.

human_interaction_patterns.timeout_behavior: No explicit timeout configured - loop continues indefinitely until approved
human_interaction_patterns.notes: DO_WHILE loop that repeats entire review process until final approval is received. Loop condition checks workflow.variables.approved. In Temporal, use while loop with workflow instance variable tracking approval status. Consider adding max iteration limit and timeout handling to prevent infinite loops.

complexity_factors: DO_WHILE loop at top level containing entire review process
Multiple human interaction points requiring external approval
Complex conditional branching with 2 possible exit points (CompleteReview_1, CompleteReview_2)
Approval loop pattern - workflow repeats until approved

recommended_patterns.human_interaction: Use Updates for all 3 approval checkpoints (Review1Check, Review2Check, Review3Check). Updates allow validation of approval decisions and return confirmation to caller. Implement separate update handlers for each review stage or use a single parameterized handler.
recommended_patterns.error_handling: Add retry policies to all SIMPLE task activities (upload_schema, Review1.a, Review1.b, Review2, Review3, CompleteReview) for network/service failures. Use RetryPolicy with exponential backoff, maximum 3 attempts recommended.
recommended_patterns.parallel_execution: Use asyncio.gather() for FORK_JOIN execution of Review1.a and Review1.b. JOIN task is implicit in gather() - no explicit implementation needed.
recommended_patterns.loop_handling: Implement DO_WHILE as Python while loop with condition 'while not self._approved'. Add max_iterations limit (recommend 10) to prevent infinite loops. Use continue-as-new if production scenarios could exceed 100 iterations. Track iteration count for logging and debugging.
special_considerations: Deeply nested control flow (5 levels) - consider extracting helper methods for each review stage to improve readability
Multiple approval points using same data source (${user_action.output.approved}) - ensure workflow instance variables are properly reset/updated between review stages
No timeout configured in Conductor - strongly recommend adding timeouts in Temporal implementation (e.g., 24 hours per review stage, 7 days total workflow timeout)
CompleteReview task appears twice with different references (CompleteReview_1, CompleteReview_2) - can be implemented as single activity called from different code paths
Approval flag must be set by CompleteReview activities to exit DO_WHILE loop - ensure this state update is implemented correctly
Consider adding workflow queries to check current review stage and approval status for external monitoring
Review tasks may involve notification activities (email, Slack) to request human input - implement these in activity code

translation_notes: The workflow has no explicit input parameters defined (inputParameters is empty array), but uses workflow.variables.approved - downstream generators should provide reasonable default input structure for workflow starter
All three SWITCH tasks reference ${user_action.output.approved} which suggests a shared external data source - in Temporal, implement as workflow instance variable updated by Update handlers
The DO_WHILE loop contains the entire workflow logic, suggesting this is a retry-until-success pattern - common in approval workflows
JOIN task (notification_join) is purely for synchronization and does not need explicit implementation in Temporal (asyncio.gather handles this)
evaluatorType is 'value-param' for all SWITCH tasks, indicating simple value comparison rather than JavaScript evaluation
No retry policies or timeouts defined at task level in Conductor - downstream generators must add sensible defaults
The workflow uses CompleteReview task at two different nesting levels (CompleteReview_1 and CompleteReview_2) to signal loop completion - both should set the same approval flag
Review1Check, Review2Check, and Review3Check form a cascading approval chain - each approval gates the next stage
Consider adding explicit state tracking for which review stage is currently active for better observability
